subject.title: feat: Add volcengine coding plan support

question: Should CodexBar support Volcengine Coding Plan usage through a new AK/SK-signed Doubao credential flow, while keeping the separate Agent Plan bearer-key endpoint work scoped to https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/1835?
rationale: The related reports describe different Volcengine APIs and credential classes, and the request does not establish which permanent provider contract CodexBar should own.

options.title: Define a Coding Plan credential flow
options.body: Specify AK/SK storage, signed usage retrieval, supported windows, and compatibility with existing bearer-key configurations before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Limit scope to Agent Plan routing
options.body: Treat this as part of the bearer-key endpoint work in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/1835 and leave Coding Plan usage windows unsupported for now.

options.title: Defer Volcengine plan support
options.body: Keep the current Doubao behavior until a maintainer chooses a durable credential and support boundary.

recommendation.title: Define a Coding Plan credential flow
recommendation.body: Specify AK/SK storage, signed usage retrieval, supported windows, and compatibility with existing bearer-key configurations before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level provider scope and credential-storage direction require product ownership rather than a mechanical code repair.
